title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Poke Ball 151 158/165 Reverse Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and unique Pokémon card is a must-have for any serious collector. The card features a stunning Reverse Holo finish, which makes it a standout addition to any collection. With its original and authentic design, this card is a true gem for fans of the Pokémon Trading Card Game. 

The card is part of the Pokemon 151 set and has a card number of 158/165. It is a Basic stage, single product, and original print. The card is made of high-quality card stock and is manufactured in the United States. It is a great addition to any collection and is perfect for players and collectors alike.
